ktc_crash_analysis.title: Analysis of Traffic Crash Data in Kentucky (2020-2024)
ktc_crash_analysis.publisher: Kentucky Transportation Center, University of Kentucky, for KYTC
ktc_crash_analysis.note: linked from KYTC Highway Safety Resources; research_notes/ky-2026-11-08/ky-methods.md

hsm.title: Highway Safety Manual
hsm.decided: critical rate against the corridor's own sites (user, #34 item 7, docs/03); used in every state until that state's own screening is built

crash_costs.missing: KYTC prices crashes with the National Safety Council's comprehensive costs (KYTC HSIP reports 2023-2025, benefit/cost lines) and publishes no table of its own; and the public data has no A/B/C level, so only K and O could be priced and a cost total would be misleading

statewide_rates.missing: KTC publishes statewide average and critical crash rates per 100 MVM by highway type (Analysis of Traffic Crash Data in Kentucky 2020-2024, rate tables after p. ix), but CrashIQ has no Kentucky traffic counts to apply them

screening.state_method: KYTC ranks HSIP sites by the cost of excess expected crashes (KTC SPFs + Empirical Bayes, KA/B/C/O); KTC's high-crash-location critical rate uses K = 2.576 (p = 0.995), Cc = Ca + K*sqrt(Ca/M) + 1/(2M) (KTC 2020-2024, p. ix, PDF p. 11)

min_years.missing: KTC's analysis and KYTC's screening use five years of crashes (KTC 2020-2024, Table 1, PDF p. 20) but set no minimum study period for a corridor study

spf_calibration.missing: KTC develops Kentucky-specific SPFs (KAB and CO) each year rather than calibrating HSM SPFs (KTC 2020-2024, Safety Performance Functions section); not loaded (no SPF engine)
